question: How many Sundays per year must an employee have off?

final.answer: Under ArbZG § 11 Abs. 1, at least 15 Sundays per year must remain free of employment (beschäftigungsfrei). Section 12 Abs. 2 allows lower minimums for certain facility types (for example 10 Sundays for the institutions listed in § 10 Abs. 1 Nr. 2, 3, 4 and 10), so confirm whether any exception applies to this department.
